journey.name: wear screenshot blocked
journey.description:
The word entry screen blocks screenshots and screen recordings (FLAG_SECURE, debug builds included), while `android layout` still lists its tags; the screen before it can be captured. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: Fresh app, see journeys/wear/README.md › Fresh app. Backend: none. Read the screen size once with `adb shell wm size` and use the swipe written for it: 454 px (`Wear_Large_Round_API37`) or 384 px (`Wear_Small_Round_API34`); for another size scale it as in README › What differs.

actions.action: Run `adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_BACK` to close the keyboard
Take a screenshot and verify it is entirely black
Swipe to dismiss from the left edge: on a 454 px screen `adb shell input swipe 20 227 400 227 300`, on a 384 px screen `adb shell input swipe 15 192 340 192 300`
Verify the title (tag "RestoreTitle") reads "How many words?"
Take a screenshot and verify it shows "How many words?" with the 12 and 24 buttons, not a black frame
